name: HENGCE H-Score
purpose: Compare the relative strength of today's Top1/Top3 candidates without changing selection or execution authority.

market_context.method: PIT percentile against prior eligible observations only
market_context.note: Measures how strong the validated SOX/DXY market setup is relative to prior setups.

q017_selection_strength.method: PIT percentile of q017_base_score against prior eligible candidates only
q017_selection_strength.note: Primary strength component. q017_base_score remains beta60*(1+25*max(-residual,0)) with residual<=4%.

leader_separation.method: PIT percentile of leader separation against prior eligible signal dates only
leader_separation.note: Measures whether Top1 is clearly ahead or merely first among near-ties.

teacher_context.preferred_pattern: foreign selling + investment trust buying + margin declining
teacher_context.reason: 2026 causal tests showed only a small terminal-capital improvement, insufficient for trading authority.

display_contract.mandatory_label: H-Score is relative signal strength, not probability of profit.

calibration.replay_rule: For historical date t, calibration may use only observations strictly earlier than t.
calibration.live_rule: For future live dates, use the latest frozen calibration ledger produced before that session.

requirements: Monotonic realized D10/D11 return by H-Score bands on non-overlapping causal samples
Explicit approval before H-Score can affect capital allocation or switching
